Tariq Osei
tariq.osei@example.com | Denver, CO
Tariq Osei has 6 years of experience in marketing. Most recently, Marketing
Manager at Tidepool Retail (2025-2026), where they managed social media
calendars across 2 brand accounts. Before that, Marketing Coordinator at
Mesquite Retail (2022-2025). Before that, Marketing Intern at Crestpoint Retail
(2020-2022). Education: M.S. Business Administration, University of Maryland,
2019; B.A. Business Administration, NC State University, 2016. Core skills:
HubSpot, Content strategy, Email marketing, Social media, Canva, Google
Analytics.
